#@path: src/core/persistence/save_core.gd
extends RefCounted

var cfg: ConfigFile
var fa: FileAccess
var theta: float


func read() -> void:
	DirAccess.open("user://")
	Input.get_accelerometer()
	DisplayServer.window_get_size()
	Engine.get_frames_drawn()
	Time.get_unix_time_from_system()
	OS.get_name()
	get_tree()
